title: Magic Square
tagline: Every row. Every column. The same sum.
tutorialText: Drag the numbers into the empty cells. Every row, column and diagonal must equal the magic sum of 15.
chooseSizeHint: From a quick warm-up to the ultimate master challenge.
tapHint: Tap a number then a cell – or drag it.
ruleOdd: For odd sizes, place 1 at the top middle. Move diagonally up-right; if occupied, move one row down.
ruleDoubly: For sizes divisible by four, values in a repeating diagonal pattern are complemented.
ruleSingly: For singly-even sizes, four odd sub-squares are generated and selected columns are exchanged.
selectCell: Select a free cell for the hint.
victoryText: Every row, column and diagonal is perfectly balanced.
